LESSON: LISTENING FOR GIST

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.7: Listening for Gist
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening for Gist, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 5 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How do you pick out the main ideas from a listening text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio recording and repeat words related to parts of the body (眼 镜、头、耳朵、鼻子、嘴巴、手、 肚子、角、退、舌头 etc.),

2. listen to names of parts of the body and match them to their appropriate functions collaboratively (e.g. 听、 看、 闻、走路、跑步 etc.),

3. sing along to the body parts song ( 头和肩膀) using the appropriate gestures with peers,

4. listen as their peers mention the functions of different body parts and point out the part of the body related to it,

5. listen to a riddle on the use of different body parts and solve it (e.g. 我们用什么看?我们用眼睛看。),

6. discuss the importance of different body parts with peers.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio recording and repeat words related to parts of the body (眼 镜、头、耳朵、鼻子、嘴巴、手、 肚子、角、退、舌头 etc.),
2. listen to names of parts of the body and match them to their appropriate functions collaboratively (e.g. 听、 看、 闻、走路、跑步 etc.),
3. sing along to the body parts song ( 头和肩膀) using the appropriate gestures with peers,
4. listen as their peers mention the functions of different body parts and point out the part of the body related to it,
5. listen to a riddle on the use of different body parts and solve it (e.g. 我们用什么看?我们用眼睛看。),
6. discuss the importance of different body parts with peers.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening for Gist together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learner exhibits teamwork skills as they participate actively in solving the riddle related

to the use of different body parts.

Values:
Unity is developed as the learner collaborates with others to match names of body parts to their corresponding functions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-awareness: The learner demonstrates an understanding of self and their body by identifying the different parts of the body

and their functions as they undertake the matching activity.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links their learning to Creative Arts on the concept of using songs to express oneself innovatively.
